name: kaikei (MoneyForward / freee / Yayoi / QuickBooks Online / Xero-compatible ledger and invoices)
description: Stdio MCP server for the kaikei itonami dapp: reads journal exports (MoneyForward 仕訳帳 CSV, freee 仕訳 CSV, 弥生インポート形式, QuickBooks Online Account/JournalEntry JSON and journal CSV, Xero Accounts/Journals/ManualJournals JSON and manual journal CSV), checks them, and builds trial balance, P&L and balance sheet (kaikei, QuickBooks Report or Xero Reports shape). It also reads and writes invoices (Xero, QuickBooks Online, freee請求書 and MoneyForward クラウド請求書 JSON and CSV; Zoho Invoice and FreshBooks read only), computes consumption tax once per invoice per rate, checks the contents a Japanese qualified invoice must state, and posts invoices as receivable or payable journal entries. Pure tools over the passed text; sends and stores nothing.
author: cloud-itonami

KAIKEI_REPO.description: Absolute path to a cloud-itonami/kaikei checkout at the pinned commit. The launcher re-executes with this directory as cwd so kbb resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text from nbb.edn.
